title: Technical Business Analyst
text: Technical Business Analyst at Evolve Housing (Sydney, Parramatta & Western Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). The Company Evolve Housing is a community focused provider of social and affordable housing. We provide innovative housing services and solutions to those in need and develop partnerships that provide positive social outcomes for individuals and their communities. Evolve Housing has over 25 years' experience in property and tenancy management and a reputation for social excellence. With a current portfolio of over 4,000 social and affordable properties housing over 10,000 people, we offer the opportunity to work for a dynamic and rapidly growing organisation. The Role As part of our Business Enablement team, this role works collaboratively with key stakeholders to design, deliver and implement new solutions, enhancements, upgrades and advisory consulting services for TM1. The Right Person You are a friendly, professional, organized and positive person who thrives in a fast paced and challenging work environment. You are adaptable, self motivated, driven by deadlines and able to juggle competing priorities in a methodical and logical manner. You are committed to providing excellent customer service, have outstanding written and verbal communication skills, exceptional attention to detail and are able to convey messages in a succinct efficient manner. You have Intermediate to Advanced computer literacy and are a quick learner. Essential Selection Criteria Experience working with ERP’s and with broader systems modules (e.g. CRM, Housing Services, HRP, Assets, Finance) highly desirable; Experience in Business Analysis scoping, Application Design, Development and Testing; Extensive experience in SQL Server, working with complex stored procedures, coding ETL, reporting and systems integration tools is required (e.g. APIs) and strong technical skills across complex Data Warehouse, Data Analytics and Dashboards; A focus on process improvement and education when supporting stakeholders through the life cycle of Business Intelligence/Analytics and Data Warehousing; Strong time management skills and experience working in a dynamic, team oriented and agile environment; Demonstrated ability to be flexible, to work proactively and cooperatively in a small team and to build productive working relationships; Demonstrated ability to work independently and as an effective team member; Well-developed interpersonal and written communication skills, combined with keen persuasiveness and influencing skills; Ability to be responsive and adaptable in a rapidly changing environment; Right to work in Australia; Current valid National Criminal Check or willingness to obtain one Conditions and Benefits Generous salary, NFP salary sacrifice benefit (tax-free component with the potential to increase your take home pay), 35 hour week, flexible workplace and genuine development opportunities. Next Steps To apply, submit your resume and a covering letter addressing all selection criteria. Only short-listed candidates will be contacted. Privacy Statement: Evolve Housing is committed to respecting and protecting the privacy and rights of individuals in relation to their personal information. Our Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, store, and disclose information in accordance with the Australian Privacy Principles under the Privacy Act 1988
